reader.source_contract: Caller supplies a stable authenticated decoded-address-space source. Every requested range must be present at its exact length; unavailable ranges fail. The source must not synthesize bytes for holes. The reader does not authenticate the source or establish CKey/EKey validity.
reader.rows: Admitted direct rows retain source order and duplicate IDs. Navigation applies source-direct last-ID-wins when constructing the selected map closure.
reader.copies: Copy pairs and section coverage remain inspection metadata. Copies do not create or replace navigation parent rows.
reader.coverage: AvailableRecords keeps per-section admitted/unknown-tact state attached. Omitted sections are not converted to empty data, and partial coverage is not upgraded to complete coverage.

selected_plan.selection: The requested map must be a direct row in the admitted available snapshot. Duplicate direct IDs resolve to the last source row. A copy-only selected ID is rejected.
selected_plan.parent_closure: Follow NavigationMapFields::effective_parent from the selected direct row and require every non-root parent to resolve to an admitted direct row. The effective parent is parent_map_id when nonnegative; otherwise cosmetic_parent_map_id. Only the selected map is an output; its effective-parent ancestors are context.
rejections: missing inventory descriptor for selected map or active ancestor
invalid parent, coordinates, tile list, or navigation parameters
cumulative work or heap reservation beyond caller limits
selected_plan.coverage_boundary: The owner retains section coverage and partial source counts; it does not turn an incomplete available snapshot into a complete catalog. Callers must establish that the supplied inventory covers the requested domain. A missing row or inventory needed by the selected closure fails closed.

pipeline.behavior: Reuses the established single-tile pipeline and shared private kernel. It emits at most the requested selected map/tile; ancestor maps remain lookup context. A map/tile outside the selected output is rejected before terrain or collision source reads. Existing source verification and downward cumulative work/heap limit reductions remain in force.
caller_obligations: authenticate and acquire the DB2 source before constructing the available snapshot
provide complete inventories for the selected map and all active ancestors
provide the complete build-70450 LiquidType source so genuinely absent IDs can be distinguished from caller-omitted rows
establish terrain absence from authoritative inventory; do not translate I/O errors into absence

non_claims: no CLI profile or Map-partial v21 admission
validation_requirements: synthetic reader coverage for admitted and omitted sections, exact range failures, direct-row order, duplicates, and copy metadata
synthetic selected-plan coverage for last-direct-ID-wins, copy-only rejection, effective-parent closure, missing rows and inventories, cycles, depth, and cumulative work/heap limits
synthetic pipeline coverage for selected output ownership, ancestor-only context, pre-read rejection outside the selected tile, source verification, and downward work/heap limits
contract checks that keep caller source completeness/authentication obligations and the non-claims aligned with the public API
